payload: Acquires Graphics Group from Lucasfilm for $5M; renames it Pixar Inc. (founding act of the standalone firm).

payload: Catmull named co-founder and President of Pixar.

Pixar Image Computer hardware business closed after sustained losses; layoffs of approximately 30% of staff.

payload: Braintrust review meeting institutionalized: directors present in-progress reels; senior creatives give 'notes' with no decision authority; director chooses what to take. Formalized after Toy Story 2 crisis.
source_citation: Catmull 2014 ch. 5 'A New Kind of Theatre'; Catmull 2008 HBR p. 67-69

payload: Dailies cadence: directors and animation crew review every shot every morning; criticism normalized as routine practice.
Move from Point Richmond to purpose-built Emeryville campus designed by Steve Jobs to force cross-departmental encounters.

payload: Monsters Inc. released; $577M worldwide.

payload: The Incredibles released; $632M worldwide; Bird joined from outside Pixar, first non-original-team director.

payload: Iger reopens Pixar talks within first week as CEO; signals openness to acquisition rather than re-distribution deal.

actor: Robert Iger / Steve Jobs / Disney Board
payload: Disney announces acquisition of Pixar for $7.4B in all-stock deal; Jobs becomes largest individual Disney shareholder.

payload: 'Social Compact' (Catmull-Lasseter document) negotiated: 7-point list including Pixar HR/email/badges/sign retained; Pixar review process preserved; Pixar parties continue; Pixar exempt from Disney-wide policies.

payload: Catmull becomes President of both Pixar AND Walt Disney Animation Studios.

Acquisition closes following shareholder approval.

Disney Animation re-greenlighting process implemented: Lasseter / Catmull review existing Disney Animation projects; several projects (incl. 'American Dog' v1) sent back to development.
Braintrust transferred to Disney Animation as 'Story Trust' with same operating rules (director-owns-decision; senior-creatives-advise-only).
Ratatouille released; $623M worldwide; Academy Award Best Animated Feature.
